plan.objective: Round every amount a customer is shown to whole pence so totals never display long decimals

plan.intent: Change customer-facing money rounding precision from whole pounds to whole pence by setting the PLACES constant in src/format/money.js from 0 to 2, so roundMoney (and formatMoney and orderTotal, which delegate to it) never emits sub-penny decimals; this modifies existing rounding behavior rather than adding or removing a feature, and requires updating the whole-pound expectations in test/total.test.js (Math.round(...) becomes penny-precision rounding) plus pinning the new two-decimal precision in test/money.test.js, whose current test deliberately avoids asserting the place count.

plan.objective: Orders of one hundred pounds or more should not be charged for delivery, and every other order should be charged three pounds
expectedTests: test/total.test.js
plan.intent: Add a conditional free-delivery rule to order pricing: in src/pricing/total.js replace the unconditional flat DELIVERY = 3 addition with a threshold check that charges £3 delivery only when the order is below £100 and charges £0 at or above £100 (>= 100 is free). Threshold is evaluated against the post-discount, pre-tax goods amount (the `discounted` value already computed in orderTotal), so tax and delivery themselves do not push an order over the threshold. Existing discount (src/pricing/discount.js), tax (src/pricing/tax.js) and rounding (src/format/money.js) behaviour is unchanged and reused as-is. Extends test/total.test.js with cases covering below-threshold (£3 charged), exactly-at-threshold (free), and above-threshold (free); no other module or test file is touched, per the README's one-module-per-test-file rule.

plan.objective: Customers who have placed more than twenty five orders should get fifteen percent off instead of ten
expectedTests: test/discount.test.js
test/discount.test.js::loyal customers are discounted and new ones are not
plan.intent: Change existing loyalty discount behavior in src/pricing/discount.js: raise the qualifying threshold constant LOYAL_ORDERS from 10 to 25 (strict greater-than retained) and raise LOYAL_RATE from 0.1 to 0.15, so only customers with more than 25 orders receive a discount and that discount is 15% instead of 10%. No behavior is added, removed, enabled, or disabled — the discountRate signature, the zero-discount paths for undefined customers and non-qualifying customers, and the src/pricing/total.js call site are unchanged. test/discount.test.js is updated to assert the new rate and the 25-order boundary (25 → 0, 26 → 0.15); test/total.test.js and the non-pricing modules (notify, audit, export, search) are untouched, per the README rule that a change to one module must not require touching another module's tests.
